instructions_to_main_agent: Execute all frontend implementation using React and Tailwind CSS.
Ensure all components use data-testid attributes.
Implement the house construction progress animation with smooth stage transitions (0% to 100%).
Include both the collapsible live side-panel and the full dedicated Agent Activity Team tab.
Provide model dropdown selectors for each of the 8 agents.
Retain all existing workspaces (AI Chat, Email Generator, Web Research, Image Generator, Admin Console).
Enforce Mithila geometric border motifs and terracotta-marigold accent styling across all views.
